B2C AI job risk calculator landscape is saturated: 12+ free competitors including WillRobotsTakeMyJob (2017, OG), AIJobImpactCalculator (ILO 2025 + Brookings + BLS + WEF), willitreplace.me (535 jobs), MeritForge AI (76 roles, MIT-licensed open data), Kairo (CLOSEST DIRECT COMPETITOR: task-level CV analysis, skill overlap, adjacent roles, free beta, knowledge workers), JobForesight (334 titles), JobSecurityMeter (resume-based), displacement.ai, OmniCalculator, TripleTen, JobReplacementAI, jobsdata.ai.

Enterprise workforce audit landscape is crowded: 8+ well-funded competitors including JobRoute (HRIS integration, SOC 2, version-locked 1,016 O*NET scores), INOP (BBRA framework, 40K+ roles, 7 research frameworks), Etter by Draup (task analysis, HRIS/ATS, SOC 2/GDPR/ISO 27001), RoleRisq (CSV to board-ready PDF in 48h, Anthropic Economic Index), Nexova (replaces $500K consulting, 60+ archetypes), Gloat (AI Impact Agent, 14 tools), EDLIGO (FTE impact), GoFIGR (free 3-min assessment, talent scout).

Veterans/military crosswalk landscape: O*NET Online Military Crosswalk (official, free), CareerOneStop Veterans Job Matcher (government, free), VeteranCareerPath.com (AI MOS translator, all 6 branches), SmartVeteran/Cadient (1,200+ MOS codes, NLP, ATS integration, 91% accuracy, B2B employer-facing), NextOp (end-to-end AI transition coach, 5 government data sources). Moderate competition; government tools are free but basic.

Coaching platform landscape: Coaching.com ($148-$2,485/mo, dominant white-label), BetterUp ($4K+/person/year enterprise), Sounding Board (~$28M revenue, B2B leadership), RapidDev (custom white-label builds at $13K-$25K). AI Career Coach Market: $5.48B (2025) to $6.69B (2026), 22.3% CAGR. 122,974 coach practitioners globally (ICF 2025 Global Coaching Study). White-label career/coaching platforms already exist (Coaching.com, RapidDev) — uniqueness must be demonstrated at the workflow-and-evidence level, not claimed as category-unique. Intry's $149 tier is a pricing reference, not proof that coaches will buy this product.

Competitor pricing benchmarks: Kairo (free beta), WillRobotsTakeMyJob (free, ad-supported), AIJobImpactCalculator (free), MeritForge AI (free + embeddable), JobRoute (enterprise, custom pricing), RoleRisq (free 30 days then paid), Nexova (paid plans), GoFIGR (free 3-min assessment + paid platform), Coaching.com ($148-$2,485/mo), BetterUp ($4K+/yr). Product's $29/mo Defender is competitive for B2C; $149/mo Coach Pro is significantly cheaper than Coaching.com ($148 minimum) while offering automation-specific features nobody else has.

User preferences: plan-first approach for non-trivial tasks, subagent strategy for context cleanliness, self-improvement loop after corrections, verification before done, demand elegance, autonomous bug fixing. Target audience defined as mid-career professionals (28-45), knowledge workers. Color direction: warm/grounded dark mode, teal/amber accents, NO purple. Messaging: empowerment + credibility, NO fear-based headlines.

Product has extensive verification infrastructure: 20+ npm verify scripts, Playwright E2E smoke tests (7 passing), commercial proof-pack verifiers, claim-boundary scanners, data-provenance checks, secret hygiene checks. All verification commands pass. However: $0 revenue, no live checkout proof, no live MRR, no paying customers, no partner outcomes. Product is code-complete but commercially unvalidated.

Report generation function partially secured: JWT auth added, user derived from token. Caller-controlled counselor_id and report_data removed. Idempotent credit ledger (reserve/complete/refund) added. All inputs HTML-escaped. Proof boundary section added. Remaining gaps (R1 in progress): RPC grants still to authenticated (must be service_role only), no private storage bucket (raw HTML returned inline), no retrieval/resume endpoint, Deno type error on line 293, hardcoded O*NET 30.3 version in proof boundary, no daily expiry purge.

ICF 2025 Global Coaching Study reports 122,974 coach practitioners globally. This corrects the audit's earlier 109,200 figure (ICF 2023). This does not establish demand from career coaches specifically — it is a market size reference only.

Intry's $149 tier is a pricing reference for the coaching tools market. It is not proof that coaches will buy this product. Price anchor only — does not validate willingness-to-pay for automation-specific white-label reports.

Coaching.com offers white-label coaching platform capabilities. White-label as a category is not unique. Product uniqueness must be demonstrated at the workflow-and-evidence level (source-labeled O*NET grounding, human-review boundary, proof-pack system) rather than claimed as category-unique.
